model: Life insurer FCFE on distributable underlying earnings at cost of equity (engine route)

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (2.9% 3yr) diverges >30% from EPS CAGR (7.9% 3yr). Cause is capital return, not weak earnings: dividends plus buybacks (FY2025 3,771 incl. $1,707m buybacks) consumed ~90% of underlying NI, and the 5yr equity CAGR straddles the IFRS 17 restatement (-$4.9bn). Equity CAGR is therefore not used as the growth anchor.
historical_growth.notes: IFRS 17 revenue (insurance revenue + net investment result + fee income; FY2022 5,769 vs FY2023 40,774) is dominated by fair-value swings on assets backing liabilities and is not a growth measure; revenue CAGRs set null. Operating/free cash flow for a life insurer is swamped by policyholder flows (FY2021 OCF -1,857) and is not an owner-FCF series; FCF CAGRs set null. Underlying EPS FY2024 6.66 -> FY2025 7.45 (+12%); Q1'26 +4%, Q2'26 +13% YoY. Reported EPS 5yr CAGR crosses the IFRS 4/17 break and is indicative only.

scenario_narratives.base: Sun Life compounds aggregate underlying earnings ~7% near term (10% per share with buybacks), ROE drifts from ~19% toward but not reliably above the 20% target, and the company distributes ~80% of underlying earnings via a 40-50% dividend payout plus NCIB buybacks. MFS outflows continue but are offset by institutional/Solutions mandates and private-markets growth at SLC; LICAT rebuilds from 145% as the BGO/Crescent buyout capital is absorbed.
scenario_narratives.bull: The multi-pillar model delivers: Asia (bancassurance, Malaysia JV majority, Bowtie) grows double-digit, SLC Management's alternatives platform rides the institutional shift to private credit and real estate, US Group Benefits margins recover, and MFS stabilises through active ETFs. Underlying ROE holds 20%+, M&A integration charges fade, and capital conversion rises toward the ~100% organic capital generation printed in FY2024-25.
scenario_narratives.bear: MFS's active-equity retail franchise keeps bleeding to passive and an equity bear market cuts AUM-linked earnings (~47% of underlying), real-estate and credit experience stays negative, and US health/benefits pricing tightens. LICAT, already down to 145% after M&A, constrains buybacks, financial leverage (23.8%) limits flexibility, and conversion falls to ~70% as capital is retained. Aggregate earnings grow low-single-digit and the market pays a trough multiple.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the common shareholder's claim on distributable underlying earnings, discounted at a CAD cost of equity, with no debt deduction (the stream is post-interest and post-preferred). Underlying NI is management's own capital-planning measure and excludes mark-to-market noise that dominates IFRS 17 reported earnings; the conversion ratio (78-80% base) haircuts it for the capital needed to grow and the recurring items it excludes. Cross-check: BVPS 42.49 (Q2-2026) at an underlying ROE of ~19% and CoE of 9% with ~4% long-run growth supports a justified P/B of roughly (0.19-0.04)/(0.09-0.04) = 3.0x, i.e. ~$127/share; the market price implies ~2.6x book.
key_risks_to_valuation: MFS net outflows (largest single asset-management earnings contributor) accelerating as US retail rotates to passive
Equity-market drawdown: ~47% of underlying earnings is AUM/fee-linked
LICAT at 145% (down from 157%) after BGO/Crescent buyouts may slow buybacks and reduce conversion
Underlying NI excludes recurring acquisition/integration charges and persistent negative real-estate experience; if those keep recurring, the earnings base is overstated
Rates and credit spreads: long-duration liabilities and general-account credit/real-estate exposure

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 79.99-118.99
data_sources.financials: SLF.TO_Metrics.csv and kpis (core_metrics, IFRS 17 FY2022+); Q2-2026 MD&A (underlying NI reconciliation, LICAT, organic capital generation, NCIB, capital transactions); FY2024/FY2025 annual MD&A (organic capital generation, common dividends)
data_sources.qualitative: SLF.TO_Analysis.json (medium-term objectives, MFS flows, LICAT, leverage)

inputs.sbc_source: Share-based payments (FY2025 AR Note 18, $217m expense) are already charged inside underlying net income; MFS management-share fair-value swings are excluded by management as a notable item. Not deducted a second time, so sbc_pct_path is zero.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: Q2-2026 underlying NI 1,123 / underlying diluted EPS 2.02 = ~556m (period-end basic 553.7m). Held flat: buybacks are part of the distributed FCFE stream, so shrinking the count as well would double-count them. SLC Management Equity Plan (Q1'26, settles in SLF common shares) is a small dilution source absorbed in the flat count.
inputs.stream_definition: 'Revenue' in this engine run is TTM underlying net income to common shareholders (FY2025 4,201 - H1'25 2,060 + H1'26 2,173 = 4,314). 'EBITDA margin' is the FCFE conversion ratio (share of underlying NI distributable to common holders after capital needed to grow). D&A, capex, cash tax, SBC and working capital are all zero because underlying NI is already after tax, interest, preferred dividends and NCI.
inputs.fcfe_conversion_anchor: Organic capital generation (capital above LICAT requirement, ex markets/non-recurring) plus common dividends: FY2024 2,104+1,875=3,979 (103% of underlying NI 3,856); FY2025 2,256+1,975=4,231 (101% of 4,201); H1-2026 602+1,042=1,644 (76% of 2,173). Base uses 80%: the full-year ~100% figures count new-business CSM as capital before it is cash, underlying NI excludes recurring acquisition/integration/restructuring charges (~$100-200m/yr) and persistent negative real-estate experience, and part of the aggregate growth path is bought (BGO/Crescent buyouts $2.4bn, Bell Partners, Malaysia JV) with capital that would otherwise be distributed.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity, not WACC: the stream is post-interest and post-preferred, so it is discounted at the common equity rate and no debt is deducted. CAD basis: Government of Canada 10y ~3.3% + beta ~1.05 x 5.0% ERP = ~8.6%, rounded to 9.0% base for equity-market (MFS/AUM-linked ~47% of earnings) and credit/real-estate sensitivity. Bull 8.5%, bear 10.0%.
inputs.lease_treatment: Not applicable: underlying NI already bears lease cost.
inputs.nci_treatment: Underlying NI is attributable to common shareholders, i.e. already after NCI (NCI equity $264m FY2025) and preferred/LRCN distributions. No further deduction.
inputs.debt_treatment: net_debt held at 0 per the financials convention. Holdco subordinated debt ($2bn issued H2-2025, $750m June 2026) and the LRCN reset are serviced inside underlying NI; deducting them again would double-count. Holdco cash and liquid assets ($2.3bn at 30 June 2026) are NOT added back: they sit against the LICAT buffer (145%, down 12pts in H1-2026 on M&A) and the pending Bell Partners / Malaysia JV payments.
inputs.notes: Model choice: dcf-methods routing table puts insurers on BVPS compounding x exit P/B; overridden to FCFE at cost of equity on underlying earnings, the same precedent as the other life insurers in this folder (PRU, MET, GL, LGEN.L). Reasons: (1) IFRS 17 restated equity down ~$4.9bn at the 2021/22 transition, so the book series is not a continuous compounding base; (2) ~$13bn+ of value sits in the contractual service margin, which is outside IFRS 17 book equity, so P/B understates franchise value inconsistently across peers; (3) Sun Life returns >100% of organic capital in some years via buybacks, so BVPS growth (5.2% 3yr) understates per-share earnings growth (underlying EPS 3yr ~9%). BVPS x P/B is retained as a cross-check in valuation_philosophy. Growth paths are aggregate underlying NI, not EPS: buyback accretion is captured by distributing FCFE, not by also growing the per-share stream. 10-year horizon because growth is still above terminal and conversion steps up as Asia/asset-management mix rises.

bear.growth_rationale: MFS retail outflows (US$16.3bn Q1'26, US$22.9bn Q2'26) keep compressing the largest asset-management earnings stream, an equity drawdown cuts AUM-linked fees, and US group-benefits pricing pressure persists; aggregate underlying NI grows low-single-digit.
bear.terminal_rationale: Cap 12x FCFE = ~8.4x underlying earnings at 70% conversion, a trough life-insurer multiple. Gordon at 10%/2.5% is ~13.7x, cap binds.

base.growth_rationale: Aggregate underlying NI grew 7.6%/yr FY22-25; management's 10% underlying EPS target includes ~2-3pts of buyback accretion, so ~7% aggregate is consistent with it. Fades to 3.5% as growth converges on nominal GDP across Canada/US/Asia.
base.terminal_rationale: Cap 15x FCFE = ~12x underlying earnings at 80% conversion, a mature life-insurer multiple. Gordon at 9.0%/3.5% is ~18.8x, so the cap binds.

bull.growth_rationale: Underlying ROE reaches and holds 20%+, Asia compounds double-digit, SLC/BGO/Crescent private-markets platform lifts fee earnings, MFS outflows stabilise via Solutions/ETF mandates.
bull.terminal_rationale: Cap 17x FCFE = ~15x underlying earnings at 88% conversion. Gordon ~23x, cap binds.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 20% because MFS outflows have worsened two quarters running, LICAT fell 12pts in H1-2026 and financial leverage rose to 23.8%; no solvency risk, so not higher. Base 50% reflects management tracking close to its medium-term objectives (FY2025 underlying EPS +12%, Q2'26 ROE 19.1%). Bull trimmed to 30% because it needs Asia, SLC and an MFS stabilisation to all go right at once.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
